source_document: Mowi Annual Report 2025 (FY2025, signed Bergen 24 March 2026), https://mowi.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Mowi-Annual-Report-2025.pdf
notes: Mowi does not present a separate 'Retained earnings' line. The accumulated-profit reserve is the 'Other equity' column in the Statement of changes in equity (profit less dividends, plus minor OCI items) — used as the retained-earnings input for Altman X2 and disclosed as such. 'Stockholders Equity' is equity attributable to owners of Mowi ASA (excl. non-controlling interests), matching yfinance's semantics. FY2022 retained earnings requires the FY2023 annual report and is still pending.
